title: 5x Candy & Sweets Ferocious | 70/30 Shortfill Bundle
description:
Ferocious Candy & Sweet Flavors 70/30 Shortfill Bundle:
The ultimate mash-up of our favorite candy/sweets flavors! This E-Liquid-combo package combines new and classic flavors. If you enjoy our Ferocious candy vape liquids in a 70/30 blend, you’ll love this combination!
We’ve mixed our delicious, flavour-blasting sweet treat flavours in 120ml bottles to save money while stocking up on your absolute fave E-liquids; this is the ideal bundle for individuals who adore candy flavours worldwide.
Black Jack
–
Delicious blend of sweet aniseed and liquorice with slight citrus undertones.
Pineaple Raspberry Chews-
Distinctive, vibrant flavors of pineapple and raspberry and added some sweet candy notes.
Perfect Pear Drop
–
The great taste of classic pear sweets.
MarshMellow-
Sweet, light marshmallows with hints of strawberry and vanilla.
Hubbly Bubbly
–  will you chew chew chews me?
Vape juice is made with a 70/30 mix (70% VG to 30% PG). As VG is thicker than PG, you’ll need a high-powered Sub Ohm device to ensure the E-liquid is vaporised correctly. Our Ferocious Flavours Vape Liquids are available in a variety of quantities and intensities. 120ml Shortfill Bottles of 0mg 70/30 vape juice are available.
If you want to add nicotine to your Shortfills, we have 100ml and 120ml bottles available with 3mg and 6mg nicotine strengths. We have 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg in stock, so you can just pop it into your tank and start vaping right away!
Ingredients
Vegetable Glycerine (70%)
Propylene Glycol (30%)
Vapoholic Flavouring
Nicotine Free, Freebase Nicotine, or Nicotine Salts
What’s in the Bundle?
1x Black Jack Shortfill
1x Pineapple Raspberry Chews Shortfill
1x Perfect Pear Drop Shortfill
1x Marshmallow Shortfill
1x Hubbly Bubbly Shortfill
Specifications:
Ratio
70/30
Size
10ml, 100ml, 120ml
Nicotine Strength
3mg, 6mg
Flavor
Black Jack, Candy, Pineapple, Raspberry
Highlights:
5x candy flavoured Ferocious e-liquids for you to try!
Delicious flavours in a 70/30 mix for sub-ohm vaping!
Perfect for cloud-chasing vapers
5 popular sweet e-liquids bundled together to save you even more money
